unserved_shadow_model.decision: np:* agent types and the Path A next() name a model id no API serves, so any fallthrough is refused by the API before inference; the placeholder prompt remains as a second layer. The fallthrough detector also treats a shadow turn.complete with reason 'error' as a fallthrough.
unserved_shadow_model.label: L
unserved_shadow_model.observation: $.agent.register accepted model ids no API serves ('claude-np-shadow-unserved', 'np-unserved'); spawn resolved to them and a forced fallthrough sent them verbatim (tripwire log model field).

agent_summary.decision: Shadows must run on a model id no API serves; that is the only supported mechanism found that keeps agent summaries from billing a shadow. This is a hard requirement of the mod, checked by the harness (tripwire model field) in interactive runs.
agent_summary.label: L
agent_summary.observation: In interactive sessions the engine's [AgentSummary] timer forks each running background agent about 20 s after it starts and requests a summary (debug 'source=agent_summary', cc_is_subagent=true): 6 refused requests per timer at the tripwire. The fork does not pass through turn.step (a turn.step hook answering unlisted agent ids saw none). The request names the agent's own model: with model 'np-unserved' all summary requests named 'np-unserved'. The engine skips the failed summary silently ('Skipping API error message').

auto_mode_default.decision: Shadow types set permissionMode explicitly (G6) so mirror calls never reach the auto-mode classifier.
auto_mode_default.label: L
auto_mode_default.observation: Interactive sessions start in auto mode in this build; the auto-mode check of a tool call is a model request (a Path A Agent call was 'Not run · auto mode's check had no usable answer' with 2 tripwire requests).

G0.decision: Harness runs are free only with HOME=<tmp>, the dummy key and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at the tripwire, and only when the tripwire count is zero. The harness enforces all three. A real-HOME OAuth probe was not run: harness runs never see Keychain credentials (shown above), and the probe would write the real ~/.claude.json and could bill.
G0.label: L
observation: Mod tests/integration/claude_mod/mods/g0_fault throws in the main loop's turn.step after yielding text, with no .catch. Debug log: 'turn.step; left mid-stream; what it yielded stands, the rest came from beneath it', then 'dispatching to firstParty model=claude-opus-5-5' (a real fallthrough, X10).

Under env -i HOME=<tmp> with no API key, no credential source resolved ('Could not resolve authentication method'): Keychain OAuth is not found under a temporary HOME on this Mac, contrary to the spec's assumption. The fallthrough failed client-side; tripwire hits 0.

With a dummy ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, all 6 fallthrough requests reached the tripwire at /v1/messages (HTTP 400). Result record: duration_api_ms 0, total_cost_usd 0, modelUsage {}. Reproduced twice (labels g0-dummy-key, g0).
duration_api_ms was 0 on a run whose 6 refused requests reached the stub, so duration_api_ms alone does not prove the absence of a model request; the tripwire count is authoritative.

G1.decision: Native tasks list is the primary list. The description carries '<Model label> <effort> · <title>'. Shadow-type model ids are self-describing because the agent view header shows them. Background sessions (←) are outside the verified design and are recorded as a lifecycle risk for G10.
G1.label: L
observation: Path A shadow row in the native tasks list below the prompt: '◯ npx:mirror  GPT-6.1 Sol high · codebase review   5s · ↓ 28 tokens' under '⏺ main' (type name, the spawn description, elapsed, reported tokens). The transcript row reads 'Backgrounded agent (↓ to manage · ctrl+o to expand)'.

Navigation: ↓ enters the list with the cursor on main; a second ↓ selects the shadow; Enter opens its transcript in the main view. The view shows the brief as the first row, assistant text, the mirror tool as an MCP row ('npx - mirror_exec (MCP)(command: "echo hello")  ⎿ Running…'), a spinner with elapsed and tokens, the description on the composer's border and the composer placeholder 'Message @npx:mirror…'. Esc returns to main.
The agent view header shows the agent's model id verbatim (Haiku 5.5, or 'np-unserved').
No separate activity text is shown on the row; the row's text is the spawn description.

The ← key does not open the agent list in this build: it moves the conversation into a Claude daemon-hosted background session ('bg-leftarrow'), spawning 'daemon run --origin transient' with spare bg-pty-host processes that outlive the terminal. The harness swept them by their temporary HOME.

G10.decision: The shadow registry is mirrored to $.store keyed by agent id (bounded, pruned) and consulted in agent.spawn (resume fires before any step) and for any unknown turn.step id; this survives /clear and --resume. After resume, completed shadows remain in the transcript but not in the tasks list; running survive_parent workers are offered for re-attach.
G10.label: L
observation: /clear: session.end reason 'clear'; $.agent.list() still lists the completed shadow, but $.state reads empty (it is per session id).

claude --resume <id>: the transcript (including the shadow's rows) is restored; $.agent.list() and $.state are empty; SendMessage to the old shadow id resumed it from its saved transcript (agent.spawn resume), and a mod with no record of it passed its step through.

G11.decision: Report output tokens on stop chunks; session.compact {skip} for shadows remains as a guard.
G11.label: L
observation: Tasks-list rows show engine token estimates ('↓ 12 tokens'); stop-chunk usage surfaces in turn.complete (X7) and is not billed.
/cost after shadows: 'Total cost: $0.0000 … Usage: 0 input, 0 output, 0 cache read, 0 cache write'.
No session.compact was raised for any shadow, including the 601-step run.

G12.decision: The production mod must validate and type-check clean (tsc -p integrations/claude/mod/np/.claude-plugin/types) on every change.
G12.label: L
observation: claude --version 2.1.314 (CLI) and 2.1.309 (desktop); the types header reads 'Written by Claude Code 2.1.314.'; claude plugin validate passes for every harness mod on both builds.
tsc 5.9.3 (scratch dev tool) type-checks a mod with the engine-laid .claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json; the strict config caught real API misuse in throwaway probes.

G13.decision: Delivery owner 'mirror' for Path A generations and for every generation created by a forwarded follow-up (typed or SendMessage), including on adopted shadows; 'native' for Path B/C initial generations.
G13.label: L
observation: Agent-tool (Path A) first run: notifies the parent.
$.agent.spawn first run (any origin): does not ('already-notified').
Resume through model SendMessage / $.session.send: notifies.
Resume by the person typing: notifies.
Person follow-up typed while running: folded into the run; the run's single completion notifies.
Killed shadows notify with status killed.

G2.decision: Native view switching is primary; the pane viewer with its own Input is kept only for degraded mode.
G2.label: L
observation: $.ui.view({agentId}) from a command.run hook and from a band Button press both returned {} and switched the main view to the shadow (band read e.props.view.agentId = the shadow). $.ui.view({}) from a press returned to main.
While viewing a shadow the composer reads 'Message @<type>…' and the next Enter goes to that shadow.

G3.decision: Capture from session.append only (the G3 fallback is the primary path): doors 'prompt' and 'delivery', origins 'composer' (-> human-claude-view) and 'coordinator' (-> parent-model), never door 'queue'. Strip the versioned framings (prefix and suffix, with and without <system-reminder>). The first coordinator row of a run started by a spawn is the brief and is consumed, never forwarded.
G3.label: L
observation:
Person-typed to a running shadow: the row shows '· 1 queued'; the text is folded into the running run as a session.append row door 'delivery', origin {kind:'composer'}, type 'attachment', text '<system-reminder>
The user sent a new message while you were working:
<text>

This is how Claude Code surfaces messages the user sends mid-turn — within the running turn, often alongside the next tool result, rather than as a separate conversation turn. Address the message above as you continue this turn.
</system-reminder>'. The next turn.step of the same run sees it.

Person-typed to a completed (or failed) shadow: agent.spawn resume:{agentId}, a session.append row door 'prompt', origin {kind:'composer'}, type 'user', the same framing without <system-reminder>; a new run starts (turn.step index 0).

Parent SendMessage (tool) raises session.send {to, text, origin:{kind:'model'}} -> {isDelivered:true}; to a completed shadow: agent.spawn resume, row door 'prompt', origin {kind:'coordinator'}, text 'The coordinator sent a message while you were working:
<text>

Address this before completing your current task.'
The brief of every new shadow is a row door 'prompt', origin {kind:'coordinator'}, unframed.
No session.receive event and no prompt.submit with agentId were raised for any input to a shadow.

G4.decision: Fallback: Esc is not mapped to an interrupt. A killed shadow (Esc, x, TaskStop) stops its worker's current task; the [Interrupt] button and /np interrupt are the interrupt path; [Stop all] cancels groups. A held step aborts with the dispatch (next.signal); the mirror hook ends its waits on it.
G4.label: L
observation: Esc in a running shadow's view and 'x' on its tasks-list row ('Enter to view · x to stop') produced the same events: the held tool call aborted ('[Request interrupted by user for tool use]' note row), turn.complete reason 'aborted', isAborted true, $.agent.list status 'killed', and a parent task-notification with status killed ('was stopped by user').
Model TaskStop {task_id} on a running shadow produced the same pattern; the notification reads 'was stopped by Claude'.
Esc in a shadow view therefore stops the agent; it is not a turn interrupt, and nothing in the events distinguishes it from 'x'.

G5.decision: Shadows are spawned only inside an awaited hook frame: agent.spawn (Path A), tool.call observers (Path B), command.run and on('ui.press', {element}) hooks (Path C). Never from timers, detached loops, onPress closures or continuations after a hook returns.
G5.label: L
observation: turn.step saw shadows spawned from session.start, command.run, an on('ui.press') hook, tool.call (X1) and the engine's Agent call (Path A).

It did not see shadows spawned from a $.clock.after timer or from a Button onPress closure: debug 'turn.step skipped: re-entry (the plugin's own code raised it; origin npi)' — a spawn outside any hook frame carries the plugin-level origin, which skips every hook of the plugin; the shadow fell through.

G6.decision: AgentSpec.permissionMode 'dontAsk', never inherited; tool.check allows only the mirror for shadows. No permissions.allow rule is installed. The auto-mode completion review is parent usage, documented.
G6.label: L
observation: Parent modes default, acceptEdits, plan and auto x shadow permissionMode inherit, bypassPermissions, dontAsk: every mirror tool call ran with no prompt; none was classified.

In auto mode only, after a shadow completed, the parent's auto-mode classifier reviewed the result entering the parent ('[auto-mode] new action being classified: tool=unknown_tool', Sonnet 5 then Opus fallback, source side_query), independent of the shadow's permissionMode. It is the parent's own safety check on content entering its context.

G7.label: L
observation: Desktop engine: /Users/danny/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude-code/2.1.309/5af865b9901c/claude.app/Contents/MacOS/claude, Claude Code 2.1.309, sha256 40fa5522dc98b3b85d7122c1159b900891107ef6c198e3c8d0fd222586c13e31, codesign Identifier com.anthropic.claude-code, TeamIdentifier Q6L2SF6YDW.

Headless contract on that binary (zero-API harness): claude plugin validate passes; shadow stepping, $.session.send resume and .catch containment of throw and stall reproduce; a .catch that returns nothing falls through to the tripwire naming the unserved model.
G7.pending: Desktop rendering of shadows, band and pane; $.process and $.http(socketPath) inside the desktop host; CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET presence; messaging a shadow; $.ui.copy and $.ui.notify. These need a person at the desktop app with the mod installed (one consolidated request).

G8.decision: A mirror step never stays open longer than 8 minutes without yielding: past that it ends with a mirror 'waiting' tool call, which holds until the next event (proven to 20 min, looped in 25 s long-polls). maxTurns is left at the engine default.
G8.label: L
observation: A mirror tool call held 20 min completed (1200043 ms), not aborted.
A single silent turn.step was aborted at exactly 600 s (turn.complete reason 'aborted').
601 steps in one shadow completed with the default maxTurns.
6 concurrent Path A shadows held 60 s each all completed; peak RSS of the claude process 339 MB (601-step run 587 MB).

G9.decision: Cursor and pending state live in $.state; module memory is a cache rebuilt from $.state.
G9.label: L
observation: Editing the mod during a held mirror tool call: 'npi: reloaded (16 hooks…)'; the old module instance finished the held call (20007 ms) and the new instance re-ran session.start with $.state intact and answered the next step from $.state. The shadow completed normally.

harness.environment: env -i with HOME, PATH, TMPDIR, LANG, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=tripwire, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=dummy, NP_MOD_HEADLESS=1, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1

X1.delta: $.agent.list() entries carried id, description, type and status only: no spawnedBy field was present.
X1.label: L
X1.observation: $.agent.register returned {agent:'npx:mirror'}; $.agent.spawn from a tool.call hook returned {model:'claude-haiku-5-5', agentId}; stream task_started has task_type local_agent, subagent_type, description, is_backgrounded true.

X10.delta: A synchronous CPU-bound spin is NOT contained by .catch: the shared hooks worker missed its heartbeat for 5000 ms, the engine unloaded the plugin ('npx was unloaded: it crashed the hooks worker'), skipped the in-flight turn.step and ran what was below it: 6 real requests (tripwire). Bounded per-step CPU is a fail-closed requirement, not only a performance budget.
X10.label: L
X10.observation: A shadow step that throws, with .catch returning a complete TurnStepResult: contained (catch kind 'throw'), tripwire 0. An awaited plain promise past the budget: contained (kind 'timeout'), tripwire 0. A .catch that yields but returns nothing: turn.complete reason 'error' and 6 tripwire hits (fallthrough).

X11.label: L
X11.observation: Awaiting a 12 s plain promise in a shadow step consumed the own-time budget (catch kind 'timeout'); 90 s and 130 s $ waits did not.

X12.evidence: scratchpad x12 variants (validator output recorded here)
X12.label: L
X12.observation: claude plugin validate refused $ passed to a closure and to a top-level const alias of a function; accepted a top-level function declaration, a top-level const arrow and a function imported from the mod's own file.

X13.delta: Under HOME=<tmp> no credential source resolved on this Mac, so without the dummy key a fallthrough failed client-side.
X13.label: L
X13.observation: See G0: with the dummy key every fallthrough request (6) reached the tripwire; total_cost_usd 0, modelUsage {}.

X14.label: L
X14.observation: A main-loop step yielding a native Agent call (subagent_type npx:mirror) raised agent.spawn with origin engine/core; the shadow was answered by the mod; its first completion reached the parent (queue record, prompt.submit origin task-notification, door 'prompt' row).

X2.label: L
X2.observation: The turn.step hook saw every shadow step (agentId set) and answered alone; engine message ids msg_hook_*; result duration_api_ms 0, total_cost_usd 0, tripwire hits 0.

X3.label: L
X3.observation: A yielded mcp__npx__mirror_exec tool call ran the mod's tool.call hook; its {result} was stored as a native tool_use/tool_result pair with parent_tool_use_id linking to the spawn; no permission prompt in -p.

X4.label: L
X4.observation: Plugin tools are served by the engine's local HTTP MCP server ('served at 127.0.0.1:<port>/<secret>/npx'); a mirror call held 90008 ms completed normally.

X5.delta: CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG was not set in this run.
X5.label: L
X5.observation: A shadow step held 130 s on $.process.run(['sleep','130'],{timeoutMs:180000}) completed with next.signal.aborted false (twice in one run).

X6.label: L
X6.observation: A yielded thinking chunk produced no stored row; session.append for the shadow recorded only text and tool_use blocks.

X7.label: L
X7.observation: Stop-chunk usage {output_tokens:42, model:'spike-observed-model'} surfaced in turn.complete.usage with model replaced by the agent's resolved model; modelUsage stayed {}.

X8.label: L
X8.observation: Every completion emitted task_notification (summary = final text, output_file). The first completion of the $.agent.spawn shadow did not reach the parent: debug '[enqueueAgentNotification] skipped taskId=... status=completed ... reason=already-notified'; no prompt.submit for that run.

X9.delta:
The framing is a prefix and a suffix: 'The coordinator sent a message while you were working:
' + text + '

Address this before completing your current task.'. The brief of a new shadow uses the same door and origin (prompt/coordinator).
X9.label: L
X9.observation: $.session.send({to:{agentId}}) to the completed shadow returned {isDelivered:true}, raised agent.spawn with resume:{agentId}, appended a user row door 'prompt' origin 'coordinator', and started a new run (turn.step index 0). That run's completion reached the parent: queue record, prompt.submit origin task-notification with turnId set (folded into the running main turn) and a door 'delivery' row.
